critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.fumble.3: The line wraps the rod, and the swing goes nowhere.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.fumble.4: {attacker} flicks the rod, and the hook sails back past them.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.fumble.5: The bobber bounces off the ground.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.fumble.6: {attacker} casts at {target} and hooks the floor.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.fumble.7: The rod bends, and the strike lands soft and wide.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.kill.2: One last yank, and {target} goes down.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.kill.3: The rod cracks down, and {target} stays down.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.kill.5: {attacker} hauls on the line, and {target} drops.
critfall.flavor.fishing_rod.kill.7: The hook tears loose, and {target} falls with it.
critfall.flavor.default.crit.2: {attacker} hits {target} with everything from the shoulder down.
critfall.flavor.default.crit.3: A short hook snaps {target}'s head around.
critfall.flavor.default.crit.4: {attacker} drives a fist straight through {target}'s guard.
critfall.flavor.default.crit.6: {attacker} lands the punch exactly on the point.
critfall.flavor.default.crit.7: A hammer fist comes down on {target} like a dropped stone.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.0: The swing overreaches, fist meeting only air.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.2: {attacker} throws a punch and nearly follows it to the floor.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.3: {attacker} swings wild, and the fist sails past {target}'s ear.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.4: The jab lands short, all reach and no contact.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.5: {attacker} winds up too long, and {target} sees it all.
critfall.flavor.default.fumble.6: A wild hook spins {attacker} half around.
critfall.flavor.default.kill.1: Finished with one final, bare-fisted blow.
critfall.flavor.default.kill.4: {target} goes down to a fist and stays there.
critfall.flavor.default.kill.5: A last hook, and {target} hits the ground.
critfall.flavor.default.kill.7: Knocked down, and out for good.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.1: {attacker} strikes like a thing that has done this forever.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.2: {target} is caught square, and it shows.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.3: {attacker} hits fast and low, and {target} reels.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.4: The attack lands full on {target}, with weight behind it.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.5: {attacker} goes straight for {target} and gets there.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.6: A sudden, ugly strike catches {target} full on.
critfall.flavor.natural.crit.7: {attacker} finds {target} with all the force of a falling rock.
critfall.flavor.natural.fumble.1: {attacker} spends the attack on empty space.
critfall.flavor.natural.fumble.4: The attack falls short, and {target} is untouched.
critfall.flavor.natural.fumble.6: {attacker} comes in wild and off line.
critfall.flavor.natural.kill.1: Finished with one final, savage blow.
critfall.flavor.natural.kill.3: {attacker} brings {target} down and keeps them there.
critfall.flavor.natural.kill.4: {target} goes down under the attack and does not rise.
critfall.config.title: Critfall Rules
critfall.config.status.applies: Saved to config/critfall/rules.json, in effect at once.
critfall.config.status.server: You are playing on a server, so the server sets the rules. Ask its admin to change them.
critfall.config.status.unreadable: rules.json has a syntax error: showing defaults. Save replaces it.
critfall.config.status.save_failed: Could not save rules.json. The log says why.
critfall.config.preset.name: Preset
critfall.config.preset.tooltip: Sets everything below to a preset. Nothing is written until you save.
critfall.config.save.tooltip: Writes rules.json and applies it, like /reload. No restart needed.
critfall.config.all_settings.tooltip: Every rule in rules.json, by section. Saving there also saves your changes here.
critfall.config.invalid.range: Enter a whole number from %s to %s.
critfall.config.invalid.at_least: Enter a whole number, %s or more.
critfall.config.invalid.choice: Pick one of the listed values.
critfall.config.rules.attack_rolls.enabl: Master switch: off leaves all combat vanilla.
critfall.config.rules.attack_rolls.playe: Players' attacks roll to hit against Armor Class.
Mobs' attacks roll to hit against Armor Class.
critfall.config.rules.attack_rolls.proje: Arrows, tridents and thrown items roll when they land.
critfall.config.rules.attack_rolls.spell: Spell damage rolls to hit, or calls for a saving throw.
critfall.config.rules.damage_dice.enable: A hit deals rolled dice; off keeps the vanilla damage.
critfall.config.rules.crits.enabled.tool: Natural 20s crit. Off leaves vanilla and other mods' crits alone.
critfall.config.rules.crits.rule.tooltip: How a crit's damage is worked out.
critfall.config.rules.crits.nat20_always: A natural 20 hits whatever the target's Armor Class.
critfall.config.rules.crits.apply_effect: Crit tables may put a status effect on the target.
critfall.config.rules.crits.knockback.en: Crit tables may knock the target back.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.enabled.to: A natural 1 can set off a fumble consequence.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.nat1_alway: A natural 1 misses whatever the attack bonus.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.confirmati: A second d20 must also fail before a fumble counts.
The second d20 must roll below this for the fumble to count.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.cooldown_t: After a fumble, natural 1s are plain misses this long. 20 ticks = 1s.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.durability: A fumble can damage the weapon. Off by default.
Down to 1 durability, or lose a percentage. Never breaks it outright.
Share of max durability a fumble takes in percent loss mode.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.hit_neares: A fumble can land on the nearest creature instead.
How far away, in blocks, a bystander can be.
Off never turns a fumble into a hit on a player.
Honors the server's PvP setting and team friendly fire.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.self_damag: A fumble can make the attacker hurt themselves.
Damage a fumble deals to the attacker.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.drop_weapo: A fumble can knock the weapon out of the attacker's hand.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.stumble.en: A fumble can slow the attacker for a moment.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.stumble.sl: How long the stumble slows the attacker. 20 ticks = 1s.
critfall.config.rules.fumbles.applies_to: Whose natural 1s can become fumbles at all.
critfall.config.rules.spells.saves.enabl: Area spells make the target save instead of rolling to hit.
critfall.config.rules.spells.saves.defau: The DC to beat when a spell names none.
critfall.config.rules.spells.saves.on_su: What a successful save leaves of the damage.
critfall.config.rules.fallbacks.unknown_: Mobs without a profile: derive stats, or stay vanilla.
Weapons without a profile: derive dice, or stay vanilla.
Spells without a profile: derive dice, or stay vanilla.
critfall.config.rules.feedback.roll_visi: Who is sent the roll readout.
critfall.config.rules.feedback.flavor.en: Narration on crits, fumbles and some kills. Each player can still hide it in client.json.
critfall.config.rules.feedback.flavor.co: Least time between flavor lines on one target. 20 ticks = 1s.
critfall.config.rules.feedback.flavor.ki: Chance of a flavor line on an ordinary kill. Named mobs and bosses always get one.
critfall.config.rules.balance.global_dam: Scales all rolled damage. 1.0 leaves it as rolled.
critfall.config.rules.balance.disable_va: Armor Class already counts armor, so it does not reduce rolled damage too.
critfall.config.rules.dry_run.enabled.to: Rolls are shown, but vanilla damage still applies.
critfall.config.rules.modifier_providers: Ask a mod that supplies bonuses and AC, if one is installed.
A falling crit hit rolls two d20s, keeps the higher. Needs Critfall crits.
